condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I.A.1. The Recipient shall, not later than the Effective Date, establish and thereafter maintain, at all timesduring the implementation of the Project, a Project Management Unit, within MoFP, with a composition, mandate, terms of referenceand resources satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.3. The Recipient shall, not later than sixty (60) days after the Effective Date, establish and thereaftermaintain, at all times during the implementation of the Project, a National Technical Working Group, with a composition, mandate,terms of reference and resources satisfactory to the Association, to be responsible for, inter alia, providing quality assurance ontechnical aspects of the Project and reviewing the Project's proposed annual work plan and budget and ensuring its consistency withthis Agreement, all in accordance with the provisions of the Project Operations Manual.

Schedule 2, Section I.B.1. The Recipient shall, not later than the Effective Date, prepare and thereafter carry out the Project inaccordance with the provisions of a Project Operations Manual containing detailed guidelines, arrangements and procedures for theimplementation of the Project, including with respect to: (a) roles and responsibilities of the PMU for Project implementation; (b)budgeting, disbursement, financial management and accounting procedures; (c) procurement procedures; (d) environmental and socialstandards instruments and related guidelines; (e) monitoring, evaluation, reporting and communication; (f) corruption and fraudmitigation measures; (g) a grievance redress mechanism including provisions on sexual exploitation and abuse and sexual harassment;(h) personal data collection and processing in accordance with good international practices; and (f) such other administrative,financial, technical, and organizational arrangements and procedures as shall be required for the effective implementation of theProject, all in form and substance satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I.B.2. The Recipient shall furnish to the Association, not later than May 31 of each year, the annual workplans and budgets approved by the National Steering Committee for the Association's review and approval; except for the annual workplan and budget for the Project for the first year of Project implementation, which shall be furnished no later than three (3)months after the Effective Date. Only the activities included in an annual work plan and budget expressly approved by theAssociation (each an “Annual Work Plan and Budget”) are eligible to be financed from the proceeds of the Financing.

title.narrative: Improved submission time of annual budget

baseline.value: The annual budget has not been submitted to the Council of Ministers in accordance with PFMA in the last 2 years

target.value: The annual budget is submitted to the Council of Ministers in accordance with the timetable in the PFMA

comment.narrative: This indicator measures improvements in the timeliness of submission of the annual budget to the Council of Ministers. The law requires a preliminary budget to be submitted for consultation by end February and to the Council of Ministers by March 15 of every financial year. Elections are planned for 2023 and delays in constituting Assembly and committees are expected.

actual.value: The FY25/26 budget has not been submitted to the Council of Ministers as of May 9, 2025. This means that the deadline of March 15 has been missed.

comment.narrative: This indicator measures improvements in the timeliness of submission of the annual budget to the Council of Ministers. The law requires a preliminary budget to be submitted for consultation by end February and to the Council of Ministers by March 15 of every financial year. Elections are planned for 2023 and delays in constituting Assembly and committees are expected.

actual.value:
The FY25/26 budget was presented to, and approved by the Council of Ministers on November 14, 2025, reflecting a 145-day delay from the date required by the PFM Act. The budget was submitted to Parliament on November 27, 2025, and is pending approval.
The March 15 deadline is applied for this update since the PFMA Act Amendment 2024 had not yet been signed into law in September 2024 when the budget process begun.
